image_description: A close-up shot of two lighters resting on a human hand. The primary subject is a tall, cylindrical metallic lighter with an iridescent finish shifting between purple and blue. Behind it sits a standard rectangular disposable lighter in magenta plastic with a red top and silver metal guard. The background is a soft-focus blur of skin tones.
